result.summary: The page is mostly visually intact and functional. The main issues are minor truncation artifacts common to mobile scrollable layouts.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' restaurant card (pizza) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, which can look broken in a static screenshot even though it signals scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Capture the full card within the viewport or add a clear 'more below' affordance so the truncation appears intentional.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated with an ellipsis, losing the end of the name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to a second line, use a wider card, or show the full name on tap/long-press.
